title: Ethics, Rules of Engagement, and AI: Neural Narrative Mapping Using Large Transformer Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly focuses on 'AI ethics' and 'ethical exploration of rules of engagement' within a military context. It uses GPT-3 to map and evaluate ethical vs. unethical narrative trajectories, specifically referencing ethical dilemmas, the Nuremberg Trials, and philosophical frameworks like Utilitarianism and Deontology.
